salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-deepseek. Hugging Face dataset card by brianmatzelle (run 2026-11-05/06): the Official column (a ~1.6-bit quantized GGUF build of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 served locally with ds4-dfm-rs on one NVIDIA DGX Spark) of the capability table (chat mode; research file: 5 rows, 4 more added), of the refusal tables (9 rows) and of the thinking-mode harmful-prompt table (1 row). QUANTIZED BUILD, SELF-HOSTED, SAFETY ROWS: very probably out of the fit (quantized local build, not the API model); recorded only. The UNCENSORED column (another model: an abliterated build) is not converted. Not converted: judge counts, per-category refusals, speed, MMLU subject deltas.
